verdict.rationale: ADK is code-first, and docs note this supports 'testability, and versioning' (google-adk-gh-17), implying agents can be version-controlled via standard code practices, but there is no explicit rollback mechanism, change-review workflow, or automation history/versioning UI documented. Missing for 10: dedicated version history/rollback feature, review/approval workflow for automation changes, and any hands-on evidence of rollback in practice.
